description: Researchers at UFZ and the Paul Scherrer Institute publish OGS6-MP-LT-Drum, a customised OpenGeoSys 6 model of a cemented radioactive-waste package. The October 2020 C++ release couples two-phase transport with steel corrosion, organic degradation, cement carbonation and reactions involving siliceous aggregates. Its separately deposited study bundle contains input and output files, a GEM-Selektor 3.3 lookup-table project and post-processing materials for ParaView, R and Jupyter. Code is free under the versioned modified BSD licence, which includes advertising acknowledgement and attribution clauses; companion files use CC BY 4.0. These materials support simulation of package-scale gas production and moisture redistribution. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this tailored code. The published case uses a simplified generic drum and fixed boundary conditions, not a complete repository-lifetime assessment. Build dependencies, numerical convergence and uncertainty were not checked. Archives were not downloaded or executed.
